VERGE - playtest build

1. Easiest: run ProjectAres-Setup.exe from the release page. It installs to
   your user's Programs folder and adds desktop and Start menu shortcuts.
   Or unzip this folder anywhere you can write to (not Program Files) and run
   ProjectAres.exe. Keep ProjectAres.pck beside it: that is the game.
   (Windows may warn about an unknown publisher: More info > Run anyway.)
   From now on the game updates itself: it checks for a newer build when it
   starts, downloads it and restarts. The build number shows in the start
   screen's corner and on the phone's Servers app.
2. Open your phone (P) and go to the Servers app. Pick your own player name
   there first: every player on a server needs a different name.
3. Under "A friend's server", type the host's address and press Join.
4. Everyone must be on the same build as the host. If you see "The server runs
   a different version of the game", press "Get the update" there, or restart
   the game. Only a new engine version needs a fresh download of the zip.

Report bugs with: what you did, what happened, what you expected, where, and
the build number (the start screen's corner).
